Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game. Zimbabwe have made a very good start to the tour and they will look to continue while Ireland will look to bounce back. The second T20I will be played on Sunday, 29th August at 1200 local (1100 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

Regis Chakabva wins the Man of the Match award for his hard-fought 47 runs in this low scoring game. He says that he just aimed to take it deep as much as he could. Goes onto say the pitch was a little bit tricky and he had to take it slow. Mentions he enjoyed his time out on the field. Ends by saying credit to the bowlers, they came out and really stuck to the game.

Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe is up for a chat. He says they went back on a low score, but their players were pumped up in the field and they delivered. Adds that it was a team effort which let them get over the line. Adds the spinners all did well together, and Burl was excellent today.

Andy Balbirnie, the Ireland skipper, is up for a chat. He says that he's very disappointed with the loss. They started tentatively with the bat, if not for Simi Singh things could've been worse. Mentions he was happy with his bowlers, but also says they should've chased a low target. Goes onto say they will go onto work on their mistakes and rectify the same before the next game.

Ireland did not get going at all in the run chase. None of their batters got a start except Simi Singh who tried hard and they have been defeated quite comfortably in the end. They needed someone to stay out there but that did not happen.

Zimbabwe were superb throughout with the ball. Everybody bowled superbly and they were terrific. Ryan Burl was the pick of the bowlers with 3 wickets while he was supported brilliantly by Wellington Masakadza and Luke Jongwe. In the end, they managed to defend a total of 117 runs, a huge credit to the bowlers.

We have had a thriller of a match here and it is Zimbabwe who have managed to defend a paltry total. A superb show from them with the ball and they will be glad with the effort. Ireland will be deeply disappointed as this should have been a comfortable chase.

Simi Singh could not manage to end the game on his own, but he put in a good fight till the last ball. A full-length ball, around off. Simi Singh comes across and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. ZIMBABWE WIN THE GAME BY 3 RUNS. They have successfully managed to defend a low score and take a 1-nil lead in this series.
Benjamin White is the last man to walk out.

OUT! RUN OUT! A short ball, on off. Young looks to heave it away but misses. The ball goes to the keeper, who throws it back to the bowler. Richard Ngarava turns and clips the bails at the non-striker's end. Craig Young is short of the crease and he has to depart on a duck. Simi Singh needs to hit the next ball out of the park to get the win for his team or a boundary to make it to the Super Over.
Who will walk out at number 10? It is going to be Craig Young.

Barry McCarthy gets behind the line and looks to paddle scoop it over the keeper's head, but he only manages to drag it onto the stumps. Barry McCarthy has to depart.
Full on the pads, Simi works it to square leg for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Simi looks to cut but misses.
Very full outside off, Simi Singh looks to drive but misses. 6 needed in 5.
On middle, Singh flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Short ball on off, McCarthy pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one
Good length ball on middle, McCarthy punches it to cover for a dot.
On a length and on off. Singh punches it through cover for a single.

WIDE! Luke Jongwe can't afford to bowl extras at this stage of the innings. This one goes down the leg side. Wide called.
TWO LEG BYES! Full and on the pads. Singh looks to clip it away but misses. The ball goes to fine leg off the pads. The batters comeback for an easy second.
Luke Jongwe to bowl the penultimate over. 12 needed in 12 deliveries.
Good-length ball, outside off. Barry McCarthy lets it go through to the keeper.
Full and outside off. Singh throws his bat at it. The ball goes towards sweeper cover for a single.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good-length ball and outside off. Singh looks to cut it away but misses.
FOUR! Full toss and punished! A full toss and outside off. Singh carves it through covers for a boundary.
Full and on the pads, Barry McCarthy tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

SWING AND A MISS! On a length, outside off. The ball is moving away from the right-hander. Barry McCarthy stays back and looks to push it out but misses.
SIX! BOOM! Simi Singh is taking the chase head on. A full-length ball, on off. Simi Singh skips down the track and powers it over the long on fence for a biggie. 18 runs needed in 18 balls.

A length ball, on off. Barry McCarthy pushes it to point.
Tendai Chatara comes back into the attack now.
Full length and on off. Barry McCarthy works it towards point off the outside edge. They take one.

Full-length ball and wide outside off. Rock leaves it alone.
A length ball, on off. Singh punches it through cover for a single.

Short and on the pads. Singh works it towards long on for a single. 33 needed in 30 balls.
On off, driven to covers.
Short and outside off. Singh looks to defend it out but misses.
FOUR! EDGY! Loopy ball, around off. Singh looks to work it to the off side but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies past the keeper towards third man and finds the boundary.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off. Singh leaves it alone. Wide called.
Tap and run! Loopy ball, on off. Rock pushes it to cover for a quick single.

Full and outside off. Rock drives it to cover.

On off, pushed to long on.

WIDE! Loopy ball, down leg. Wide called.

On off, flicked to the leg side for a single.

OUT! TIMBER! Ryan Burl has certainly got his team back in the game. He has now gotten the set batter Kevin O'Brien going. Loopy ball, around off. Kevin O'Brien stays back and looks to defend it out but misses. The ball goes through the gap between bat and pad to rattle the stumps. Kevin O'Brien does not believe it. Ryan Burl is on a Hat-trick now.
Who will walk out next? It is going to be Shane Getkate.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ryan Burl gets his second wicket and makes it three for Zimbabwe. Loopy ball, full and outside off. George Dockrell latches onto it and hits it uppishly towards long off. Wellington Masakadza comes running in and takes a good low catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Wellington Masakadza b Ryan Burl

Floated and on off. Kevin O'Brien pushes it through point for a single.
Looped up, full and on off. Dockrell works it towards long on for a single.
Back of a length and on off. Dockrell guides it towards third man for a single. 59 runs needed in 60 balls.
LEG BYE! A length ball, on the pads. Kevin O'Brien looks to clip it but misses. The ball goes towards square leg off the pads. The batters collect a leg bye.

A length ball, on the pads. Dockrell tucks it to square leg for a single.
